meta.name: memory-hygiene
meta.description: Audit, clean, and optimize Clawdbot's vector memory (LanceDB). Use when memory is bloated with junk, token usage is high from irrelevant auto-recalls, or setting up memory maintenance automation.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 清理并优化向量记忆，降低令牌消耗
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果Clawdbot的记忆中积累了大量无用信息
copy.tagline_en: Audit and clean vector memory to reduce token usage
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your Clawdbot's memory is bloated with junk

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 可以检查、清理和优化 Clawdbot 的向量记忆（LanceDB），删除垃圾记忆，减少不必要的 token 消耗。
howto.when: 当记忆被垃圾信息塞满、token 用量因无关自动召回而过高，或需要设置记忆维护自动化时触发。

say.text: 检查我的记忆里有什么内容。
say.note: Claude 会执行记忆审计，列出最近存储的记忆条目。
Claude 会删除整个记忆数据库，然后重启网关。

say.text: 设置每月1号自动清理记忆。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can audit, clean, and optimize Clawdbot's vector memory (LanceDB), removing junk memories to reduce unnecessary token consumption.
howto.when_en: Triggered when memory is bloated with junk, token usage is high from irrelevant auto-recalls, or when setting up memory maintenance automation.

say_en.note: Claude will run a memory audit and list recent entries.
Claude will delete the memory database and restart the gateway.

say_en.text: Set up monthly memory cleanup on the 1st.
say_en.note: Claude will add a cron job for monthly wipe and reseed.
